MRI Safety Information
The Orion Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 720 gauss/cm.
- Gradient slew rate ≤ 200 T/m/s (per axis).
- There are no Transmit Coil restrictions.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg.
- head averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 10 minutes.
- Wait 5 minutes before the next imaging session.
3 T scanning conditions:
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 60 minutes.
Scan regions: Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below).
The image artifact extends approximately 25 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
